description: Add 'Average Price Laptop [year]' table in Analisa Tahunan tab, placed ABOVE the 'Marketshare per Brand Proc - Detail Bulanan' section. Shows average price (total/qty) per brand per month with Gaming/Non Gaming filter toggle. Columns: Bulan, ACER, ADVAN, APPLE, ASUS, AXIOO, HP, LENOVO, MSI, OTHER, All Brand. Formatted with dot separators. Yearly average row at bottom. Each brand column has distinct background color.
steps: In index.html, add a new <section> for the Average Price table ABOVE the 'Marketshare per Brand Proc - Detail Bulanan' section (the second .marketshare-section in tabTahunan). It needs: a table-header with title 'Average Price Laptop [year]', a Gaming/Non Gaming/Semua category toggle (similar to existing ms-header-controls pattern), and a table with thead/tbody/tfoot elements with IDs (avgPriceTableHead, avgPriceTableBody, avgPriceTableFoot, avgPriceYearInfo).

In app.js, create function renderAvgPriceTable() that: (a) Uses filteredData (respects global year/kota/divisi/proc filters), (b) Has its own category state variable (currentAvgPriceCategory), (c) Groups data by bulanName and brand, (d) Calculates average price as sum(total)/sum(qty) for each brand per month, (e) Shows 12 month rows (Jan-Des), each cell showing the average price formatted with dot separator (e.g. 7.485.244) or 0 if no data, (f) Shows 'All Brand' column as overall average per month, (g) Bottom row shows yearly average per brand. Brand columns ordered: ACER, ADVAN, APPLE, ASUS, AXIOO, HP, LENOVO, MSI, OTHER (alphabetical per image). Each brand column header should have a distinct background tint color (ACER=light green, ADVAN=yellow, APPLE=orange, ASUS=light blue, AXIOO=pink, HP=light purple, LENOVO=green, MSI=light yellow, OTHER=light gray as shown in image).

Wire renderAvgPriceTable() to be called from applyFilters() via safeRender, and add event listeners for the category tabs in the DOMContentLoaded handler. Also hook up the avgPriceCategory toggle buttons.

Add appropriate CSS in style.css for the avg-price table. Use distinct header background colors per brand column as described. Keep the table compact and readable following the existing monthly-kota-table patterns.
acceptance_criteria: A table titled 'Average Price Laptop [year]' appears in the Analisa Tahunan tab above the 'Marketshare per Brand Proc - Detail Bulanan' section
The table shows 12 months as rows with average price per brand per month
Numbers are formatted with dot separator (Indonesian locale)
Gaming/Non Gaming/Semua category toggle works correctly to filter the price data
Each brand column has a distinct background color in the header
A yearly average row appears at the bottom
An 'All Brand' column shows the overall average price per month
No JavaScript console errors on page load
verification: Open index.html in browser and confirm the Average Price table appears above Marketshare per Brand Proc section
Toggle between Gaming/Non Gaming/Semua and verify the table values change
findings: Implemented successfully. Used filteredData (global year/kota/divisi/proc filters apply) with additional cekGaming filter for category toggle. Brand ordering is alphabetical: ACER, ADVAN, APPLE, ASUS, AXIOO, HP, LENOVO, MSI, OTHER. The getBrandGroup function maps unknown brands to OTHER. Event listeners use data-avgprice-cat attribute to avoid conflicts with other toggle buttons.
